Task: Voice Interruption Detection.
Context: The AI is currently speaking.
Input: A fixed-size user-side audio chunk.
Instruction: Classify the audio as exactly one of the following:
1. ignorable (noise, none-target speaker talking, non-speech)
2. backchannel (short agreement, e.g., "mhm", AI should continue)
3. interrupt (meaningful speech, AI must stop)

Output only the label string without any formatting.
<audio>
Great choice! To confirm, you'd like to book one-way flight HAT271 from ORD to PHL on May 26th at 7:00 PM in economy class. How many passengers will be traveling on this flight?
<audio>
Got it. So two passengers total. I have your details on file, Sophia. For Kevin Smith, could you please provide his date of birth?
<audio>
given the above dialogue history, the incoming audio should interrupt the AI? or is it just a backchannel or ignorable audio?<audio>
ignorable
